title: Major Murphy tells Vallée about 1943 saucers and their psychotronic effect
summary: JASON tells of Major Murphy tells Vallée about 1943 saucers and their psychotronic effect, about 1943 at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he points to 1943 and he says, "You know, what if someone was experimenting with this technology? It turns out its real advantage wasn't its flight capabilities, but its psychotronic effect."

plain: A researcher identified as Jason, on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to Messengers of Deception, a book by Jacques Vallée, a well-known investigator of UFO reports. According to that telling, a man called Major Murphy told Vallée to look at 1943 and asked what if someone was already experimenting with flying-saucer technology then, adding that its real advantage was not how it flew but its "psychotronic" effect, meaning its power to affect the human mind. If true, it would mean saucers were valued as tools for influencing people rather than as aircraft.
